idea-plugin.name: Steadfast Light Themes
idea-plugin.description:
Four light themes with warm paper backgrounds and one accent colour, made for long reading and writing sessions. Text colours meet WCAG AA contrast on the background.

  • Steadfast Green: colours taken from KokybiskaSvetaine.lt.
  • Plum Evening: colours taken from Vestuvių metinės.
  • Forest and Brass: colours taken from Dovanos su vardu.
  • Powder Blue Morning: colours taken from Krikštynų dovana.

Choose a theme in Settings, Appearance and Behavior, Appearance.
